data.one_liner: A powerful extension library of Sliver with custom headers and adapters.
data.what_it_does: Provides customized sliver widgets including SliverPinnedPersistentHeader, SliverPinnedToBoxAdapter, ExtendedSliverAppbar, and SliverToNestedScrollBoxAdapter. It allows automatic calculation of extents without forcing values like minExtent, maxExtent, or expandedHeight.
use_when: You need a pinned sliver header without knowing its final extent beforehand.
You are building custom scroll views with SliverAppbars that don't require forcing expandedHeight.
You need to embed nested scrollable widgets like WebViews inside a CustomScrollView.
avoid_when: Standard Flutter slivers and app bars fully meet your layout requirements.
strengths: Calculates minExtent and maxExtent automatically using prototypes.
Simplifies creation of pinned sliver boxes and custom app bars.
Supports nested scrolling inside custom scroll views.
weaknesses: Relies on custom sliver render objects which might need careful handling for edge cases.
data.minimal_example:
SliverPinnedToBoxAdapter(
  child: Container(
    padding: const EdgeInsets.all(20),
    color: Colors.blue.withOpacity(0.5),
    child: const Text('Pinned Sliver Content'),
  ),
)
